headline: Don't buy the hype yet, and don't install AI plugins blindly
summary: Claims about reading and writing model weights got debunked, but a small model can actually pull it off; Postman was caught quietly installing an AI plugin that tries to send data out.

items.title: Postman quietly installs an AI plugin and wants to upload data
items.pitch: Postman, which you or your team have probably used, was caught auto-installing an AI plugin and trying to send all API data out; it hit 1333 points on Hacker News in one day.
why: It doesn't ask you during install; the plugin installs itself and is on by default
The target is all API data, which is the scariest part in a company environment
AI plugins like this usually have overly broad permissions, so it's worth checking yours
actions: Open Postman, go through your installed plugins in settings, and turn off any AI features you don't recognize
deep_dive: Not directly related to Claude Code or codex, but you run a bunch of AI tools every day, so this is a handy reminder.
The original post is under Postman's official GitHub repo, and HN has 449 comments arguing about it, so the details are pretty credible.
Behavior may differ by version, so check your own machine first and don't rush to uninstall.
items.signals: HN 1333 points · 449 comments · highest AI-related score of the day

items.title: Update: weight read/write claim called exaggerated, but it runs on a laptop
items.pitch: Yesterday's claim that AI can directly edit model weights was criticized as misleading; the same day, Simon reproduced it with Qwen 3.8 27B on a laptop.
why: That piece was actually a blog post, not a rigorous paper
On HN, a 995-point post questioned it and a 649-point post actually tested it
Conclusion: the hype is exaggerated, but it's true that a small model can do it
deep_dive: Doesn't affect your Claude Code work; no impact on your workflow for now, just good to know.
Basically it's about letting a model directly read and write a bunch of numbers inside the model (the weights), not a product you can install and use.
Honestly: with big breakthroughs like this, wait a week; they usually get knocked back down to size.
items.signals: HN 995-point skepticism · HN 649-point Simon test · local reproduction with Qwen 3.8 27B
